jobDescription:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

 

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

THE ROLE: 

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to serve as the senior technical leader for ROCm software validation across compute workloads and server-class systems. In this individual-contributor leadership role, you will define how AMD proves ROCm is ready to ship — from unit and component testing, through full-stack workload validation, to multi-node system-level qualification on AMD Instinct™ GPU platforms. You will set the technical direction for validation strategy, build and evolve the test infrastructure that gates every ROCm release, and personally drive the hardest debugging, characterization, and qualification problems. Your work directly determines the quality bar experienced by hyperscalers, OEMs, sovereign-AI customers, and the open-source community running ROCm in production.

 

THE PERSON:

You will set the technical direction for validation strategy, build and evolve the test infrastructure that gates every ROCm release, and personally drive the hardest debugging, characterization, and qualification problems. Your work directly determines the quality bar experienced by hyperscalers, OEMs, sovereign-AI customers, and the open-source community running ROCm in production. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the end-to-end validation architecture for ROCm — unit, integration, framework, workload, performance, stress, stability, scale-out, and system-level test layers — across multiple GPU generations and server platforms. 
  • Define release-qualification gates and exit criteria for ROCm software releases (functional coverage, performance regressions, stability hours, scale targets, RAS criteria) and drive the org to meet them. 
  • Architect the test infrastructure — distributed test runners, GitHub Actions / Jenkins / internal CI fleets, hardware lab orchestration, result data lakes, flaky-test detection, bisection automation, and self-service developer pre-submit pipelines.
  • Champion modern, agile quality engineering — shift-left testing, test pyramids, contract testing between layers, hermetic test environments, deterministic reproducers, and continuous validation in trunk.
  • Set the bar for GitHub-based quality workflows — PR gating policy, required checks, code-coverage standards, bug-bash and triage cadences, and disciplined issue management across ROCm/* repositories and partner upstream projects.
  • Lead complex escalation debug — partner with development, hardware, firmware, and customer-facing teams to root-cause the hardest multi-day, multi-node, multi-component failures and convert findings into durable test coverage. 
  • Influence the roadmap — work with product management, silicon, platform, and software architecture to ensure validation readiness for next-generation Instinct GPUs and server platforms before tape-in milestones and silicon arrival.
  • Mentor and elevate Senior and Staff validation engineers, SDETs, and SQA leads; raise the technical bar through design review, code review, and written guidance.
  • Represent ROCm validation externally — strategic customer engagements, OEM qualification programs, and open-source community quality initiatives.
  • Lead system-level testing for server nodes — multi-GPU topologies, PCIe/Infinity Fabric/xGMI, BMC/IPMI, thermal/power, firmware interactions, and multi-node fabric (Ethernet/InfiniBand/UALink) bring-up and validation.Drive compute workload validation and characterization — LLM training and inference (PyTorch, vLLM, Triton, JAX), recommender systems, scientific HPC kernels, MLPerf-class benchmarks — establishing reproducible methodology, baselines, and regression tracking.

About the Role 
 

About the role

PSS CC is building a set of AI-powered business applications on a shared backend architecture: a master orchestrator model that routes to domain-specific AI models, grounded in a canonical enterprise data model. This role builds the applications people use: the interfaces, APIs, and services that sit between that backend and the sales, finance, and operations teams relying on it.

You'll work across the stack — front-end interfaces, backend services and APIs, and the integration layer connecting to AI models and enterprise data — on whichever solution needs it most as the ecosystem grows.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain web application front-ends for the ecosystem's tools (customer intelligence dashboards, AP/AR review interfaces, quoting workflows, internal AI assistants).
  • Design and implement backend APIs and services that connect front-end applications to AI models, business logic, and the underlying data layer.
  • Work with existing Python-based services and SQL-backed data views, and help migrate them toward the platform's evolving canonical data model as it comes online.
  • Integrate application features with LLM-backed capabilities — sending the right context to a model and rendering its response — following the platform's established grounding and security patterns rather than building ad hoc AI calls per feature.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, IT leadership, and (where applicable) third-party vendor platforms to ship features end-to-end.
  • Write tests, participate in code review, and keep security and data-handling practices consistent with the platform's standards, particularly around what data can reach an AI model and what can't.

Skills

Required

  • 4+ years of professional full stack development experience.
  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern front-end framework (React preferred).
  • Solid backend experience with Python and REST API design.
  • Working SQL skills and comfort querying and shaping data from a relational or cloud data warehouse.
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs into production applications.
  • Ability to work independently across unfamiliar codebases and pick up context quickly — this role moves between projects as priorities shift.

Preferred

  • Experience building features on top of LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) — prompt/response handling, streaming responses, structured output.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) for hosting application and inference layers.
  • Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and code scanning tooling.

Nice to have

  • Background in enterprise B2B software, distribution, or ERP-adjacent systems.
  • Experience working alongside data or Machine Learning (ML) team building shared platform capabilities rather than one-off features.

How success is measured in the first 6 months

  • Shipped and maintaining at least one production-facing feature or interface within the ecosystem.
  • Comfortable working across at least two of the platform's active solutions.
  • Able to build a new AI-integrated feature following the platform's existing grounding and security patterns without requiring architectural guidance each time.

The engineering decisions you make will determine whether millions of Americans can access college. You’ll help rebuild the system that serves 17M+ applicants annually, distributes $120 billion in federal aid each year, and manages $1.6T in student loans.

The Technical Challenge

You’ll architect and ship StudentAid.gov, taking on:

  • Massive traffic spikes, with 10M+ applications hitting the system in a short window
  • Complex eligibility logic, with thousands of rules across federal, state, and school programs
  • Real-time data exchanges with the IRS, SSA, and other federal agencies
  • Accessibility requirements that directly impact students with disabilities
  • Always-on availability during peak deadlines when uptime is critical
  • High-stakes releases with no soft rollouts — changes go live for everyone at once

What You’ll Do

This is a hands-on technical leadership role — you won’t code every day, but when it matters, you’ll dive in to unblock teams and de-risk critical changes. The specific tech stack doesn’t matter — we need engineers who can work with and improve whatever technology serves the mission. Tasks may include:

  • Transform legacy systems into modern services while keeping critical systems online
  • Set technical standards across federal and contractor teams
  • Make architectural decisions that will shape FAFSA systems for the next decade
  • Review PRs across multiple codebases, spotting failure modes and simplifying changes
  • Debug complex production issues and guide teams through root-cause analysis
  • Unblock teams by writing code when the mission demands it

Who Succeeds Here

We’re looking for engineers who’ve built at scale in complex environments — typically Staff+ at a strong engineering organization, with experience in most of the following:

  • Built or operated systems serving millions of users in production
  • Led cross-team technical initiatives over multiple quarters
  • Migrated or decomposed legacy systems while keeping critical workflows available
  • Stayed hands-on with code — you can still read a diff, trace a request, and ship a fix
  • Prioritized outcomes over process — you know when to push back on bureaucracy that slows delivery without adding value

Reality Check

Compensation: This is a GS-15 technical position — the highest rung on the standard government pay scale and roughly equivalent to a Principal Engineer at a top technology company. Full federal benefits included.

The Environment: You’ll face legacy systems, federal compliance, and change-resistant stakeholders. However, you own your technical decisions — shaping architecture, influencing requirements, and driving change through consensus rather than permission.

The Impact: Your code will impact more families than most consumer apps ever reach at one of the most consequential financial moments of their lives. Once you’re in, you have technical autonomy rarely seen in government.

Interview Process

Our interview process is fully remote, consisting of 3-5 conversations that assess work experience, fit, and technical skills.

How to Apply

Please apply through USAJOBS, the federal government's official hiring site.

You keep stakeholders informed of project progress, including setbacks. Title:  Software Engineer

ABOUT ADVANCED ENERGY

Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

 

WHY BE A PART OF ADVANCED ENERGY?

Some people say it’s like working in the best of two worlds. We operate like an agile, growing, small company – you can see your work make a difference to the company every day. Things move quickly and you can see and feel it. At the same time, we’re a global company founded in 1981 and have been publicly traded for more than 28 years. We have a strong cash position, deep trust and partnership with leading customers, a global best-in-class operations capability, and a proven leadership team. We have a track record and resources to make things happen both organically and inorganically. Being part of a nimble company with a solid foundation attracts team members that are capable, driven and like a challenge. Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy – powering the future, together.

 

POSITION SUMMARY:        

Advanced Energy is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Service Engineering organization in Fort Collins, Colorado. The successful candidate will contribute to the development and evolution of software applications used for RF calibration, testing, characterization, and service of Advanced Energy products. The immediate focus of this role is participation in the development of an RF Calibration System application used to automate test workflows, interact with instruments and hardware devices, collect and analyze measurement data, and provide an intuitive operator experience. The application is developed in C#, .NET 8, and WPF using MVVM architecture. Depending on qualifications and experience, this position may be filled at the Software Engineer II or Senior Software Engineer level.

 

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Works as part of a team, balancing time and scope to meet specification and scheduling demands.
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications supporting RF calibration, testing, and service activities.
  • Develop software solutions that interface with instrumentation, hardware devices, and automated test systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to define requirements and implement technical solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve software and hardware integration issues.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support both new product development and sustaining engineering efforts for existing products.

 

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Location: Fort Collins, CO
  • Environment: Standard office environment

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

 

Required

  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

 

Preferred

  • Experience with RF, power electronics, instrumentation, automated test equipment (ATE), calibration systems, or measurement systems.
  • Educational background in Electrical Engineering or strong understanding of electrical and electronic systems.
  • Experience with Bitbucket, Jira, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software lifecycle management tools.
  • Experience modernizing legacy software applications and improving software quality standards.
  • Experience developing automated test frameworks and hardware-in-the-loop solutions.
  • Knowledge of software quality standards, coding guidelines, and software compliance processes.
  • Experience with database technologies and data management solutions.
  • Experience with Python for engineering, automation, or test applications.
  • Experience with web application or full-stack development using modern frameworks and cloud technologies.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools and workflows, such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar engineering productivity tools.
  • Understanding of responsible AI-assisted development practices, including code review, validation, testing, and governance considerations.
  • Experience working in semiconductor, industrial automation, instrumentation, or manufacturing environments.

 

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience using C# and .NET.
  • Experience developing desktop applications using WPF and MVVM architecture.
  • Experience developing software that communicates with hardware devices, instruments, sensors, controllers, or embedded systems.
  • Experience with one or more communication technologies such as TCP/IP, USB, Serial (RS-232/RS-485), Ethernet, GPIO, CAN, Modbus, SCPI, or similar interfaces.
  • Strong object-oriented design and software architecture skills.
  • Experience debugging complex interactions between software and physical hardware systems.
  • Knowledge of software development best practices including source control, code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • Experience using Git-based source control systems and modern development workflows.

 

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline.

 

COMPENSATION:                           

As required by multiple state pay transparency laws, Advanced Energy provides a reasonable range of compensation for each job posting.  Actual compensation is influenced by an array of factors including, but not limited to, skill set, level of experience, and specific office location.  The range of starting pay for this role is $85,000 to $145,000 per year.

  • Short and long-term disability and life insurance
  • Health savings and flexible spending accounts
  • Generous time off policy starting with 3 weeks of paid vacation, 7 days of paid sick time, and 12 paid holidays

We are looking for a collaborative and adaptable Software Engineer to join the Life Cycle Engineering (LCE) team supporting Insulet's embedded software for medical products. This role contributes across the full software lifecycle—including design, implementation, testing, documentation, maintenance, and continuous improvement—in a regulated, multidisciplinary environment.
Success in this role means taking ownership of the work needed by the team, whether that involves new feature development, defect resolution, design documentation, test support, or cross-functional integration. Job Posting Title: Software Engineer (Grade 8) – ACV Application and Common Security Module


Meet the Team

The Common Security Module team is a critical pillar of Cisco’s Security and Trust Organization. We operate at the intersection of cryptography, system integrity, and the Cisco Secure Development Lifecycle (CSDL). Our mission is to build the foundational security architecture for Cisco’s diverse product portfolio, ensuring our solutions remain resilient against the evolving threat landscape of the AI era.


Your Impact

This is a unique, versatile role for a Grade 8 Software Engineer who thrives on technical variety. You will bridge the gap between full-stack development and deep security engineering. You will spend time as a full-stack developer—leveraging Python, modern Angular, and Django—to maintain and enhance the cloud-based ACV application and support the Government Certification Team (GCT). Simultaneously, you will contribute to the development and support of our Common Security Modules, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure security is a core feature, not an afterthought. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys tackling complex security challenges while building scalable, high-impact software.


Responsibilities

●      Maintain and enhance the ACV full-stack codebase (Python, Django, and Angular v17+) to support government certification programs.

●      Conduct thorough security code reviews and provide actionable feedback to improve overall codebase quality.

●      Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and test new features for common security modules.

●      Assist product teams in integrating common security modules into existing and new hardware/software platforms.

●      Analyze and remediate security vulnerabilities in accordance with industry-standard CVE mitigation practices.


Minimum Qualifications

●      Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

●      4+ years (or equivalent) of relevant software engineering experience in development.

●      Proficiency in Python 3.x and C.

●      Experience with modern Angular (v17+), MySQL, and Django (4.x, ORM, and REST Framework).

●      Comfortable with Linux OS and command-line/terminal environments.


Preferred Qualifications

●      Highly desired experience in backend/frontend development, containerized applications, and CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.

●      Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, global team environment.

●      Experience utilizing AI-powered development tools to enhance coding efficiency and optimize workflows.

●      Familiarity with OpenSSL/OpenSSH cryptographic libraries and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) standards.

●      Demonstrated flexibility and agility in adapting to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

●      Experience working in SCRUM/Agile environments, alternating between developer, test, and automation roles.


Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package including 401(k), medical, dental, and vision care
  • On-the-job and cross-training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy'

What You Will Do

Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Data Science and Analytics team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable software solutions that enable analytics, data-driven decision-making, and AI-powered capabilities across the organization.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software applications, data integrations, and cloud-based solutions. You will drive technical excellence, mentor other engineers, and help shape the architecture of enterprise platforms that support strategic business initiatives.


How You Will Do It

Software Development & Architecture

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software applications and services.
  • Lead architecture and design discussions for enterprise-level solutions.
  • Develop secure, maintainable, and performant APIs and backend services.
  • Ensure adherence to software engineering best practices, including testing, code reviews, and version control.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in production environments.

Cloud & Data Solutions

  • Build and maintain integrations across cloud platforms, enterprise applications, and data sources.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to support analytics and AI initiatives.
  • Develop and optimize data processing workflows and application integrations.
  • Contribute to cloud-native solutions using Azure or comparable cloud platform stakeholders, and technical teams to translate requirements into software solutions.
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers.
  • Participate in technical planning, estimation, and roadmap discussions.
  • Drive continuous improvement through process optimization and engineering best practices.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to existing systems.
  • Support AI, analytics, and automation initiatives through robust software engineering solutions.
  • Champion code quality, maintainability, and scalability across the development lifecycle.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining enterprise software applications.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and collaborate across teams.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong proficiency in Python, C#, Java, or comparable programming languages.
  • Experience developing REST APIs and microservices.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, testing frameworks, and DevOps practices.
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake or similar technologies.
  • Understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and scalable system design.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting machine learning or AI-enabled applications.
  • Experience with Azure services and Microsoft technology stack.
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with data engineering, analytics platforms, or enterprise integrations.
  • Familiarity with IoT, smart buildings, or industrial technology environments.

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and lead through influence.
  • Strong collaboration and mentoring capabilities.
